purposes.source_height_m: Uniform normalization fits an upright recovered specimen into the existing source body; device copies receive explicitly measured mount transforms.
purposes.source_near_triangles: First measured detailed runtime candidates preserve large folds and deep cuts, not an approved game-wide budget.
purposes.source_middle_triangles: Simplify small mineral fragments and wrinkles while keeping the parent silhouette and cut.
purposes.source_far_triangles: Retain broad folded/nodule masses for distance inspection; no finite ownership or physics changes.
purposes.scar_depth_m: Real inward displacement creates a dark injury visible with emission disabled; measured on each delivered near core.
purposes.scar_half_width_m: Gives the incision broken margins instead of a painted bright line.
purposes.beam_bevel_m: Softens worked timber edges inside the existing body envelope.
purposes.wood_repeat_m: D4 metric grain density, V along the member; end grain uses the D4 half-metre mapping.
purposes.metal_repeat_m: D6 iron half-metre finish repeated at its original density.
purposes.native_bounds_m: Unchanged physical placement/resource bodies, not new tuning.
purposes.sort_visual_anchors_godot_m: Existing native presentation route locations retained exactly, including both distinct trays.
purposes.bellows_native_godot_m: Current target/impact positions are retained; the nozzle is cosmetic and adds no reach or targeting gate.
purposes.recovery_voxel_m: Closes touching raw triangles before authoring runtime solids; original surface UV charts are interpolated by nearest polygon, not unrelated vertices.
purposes.review_lighting: Shared linear-tone inspection lighting keeps original materials readable in Forward+ and Compatibility; this changes no ordinary-world lighting.
